parsed.post: Kept MATRIX_LR=0.04: 0.88479 -> 0.849797 on depth6/batch262k/warmup0.05. Next: TRAIN_SHARDS=0-9 to exclude EVAL_SHARD=10 and remove validation contamination before further LR/width sweeps.
parsed.description: Clean baseline: keep the winning MATRIX_LR=0.04 but exclude eval shard 10 from training to prevent val contamination.
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so current val_bpb values are trained on the eval shard and may not reflect generalization. Recommend final comparisons use TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' or change EVAL_SHARD.
